text:
[LCSP.5.2] **Chip-adapter baseline choice.** Each chip adapter picks its own
implied baseline ([LDIA.3.3.1]). The recommended choice for
MCU targets is:

- `implied_extensions: [constspace]` when bounded memory is the
  primary need (most embedded telemetry / control use cases).
- `implied_extensions: [realtime]` when hard WCET is mandatory
  (safety-critical / hard real-time control loops).

Adapters MAY offer both as opt-in tokens.
